title: Founding of NASA's electrostatics lab by Carlos Gier

tellings.quote: it was founded about 26 years ago by Dr. Carlos Gier, a physicist who uh spent a summer working at Kennedy Space Center.

plain: NASA's lab for studying static electricity was started around 2000 by a physicist named Carlos Gier, after he spent a summer working at Kennedy Space Center in Florida. Charles Buhler, a NASA scientist who works in that lab, tells this as its origin story, the place where he says his team has since built a kind of propulsion that pushes without fuel.
